limitations: No connected system inventory, activation, effective roles or runtime observations
Product edition/release and ABAP language-version semantics are not inferred from syntax

ABAP call resolution handles explicit static/current-class receivers and local forms; other receiver types remain unresolved

CAP CDS uses bounded declaration extraction and CSN import; imports, generated SQL names and runtime handlers are not fully linked
BTP configuration reports declarations and version constraints, not installed versions or deployment status
Integration Suite captures BPMN steps and connections; mappings and scripts are referenced, not executed or semantically interpreted
Object scope is the export directory; cross-system identity requires future system metadata
